clan.name: FightClub⚔️👊😎☕
clan.description:
Are you the next top Greifental fighter? 
Join the best bruisers this world has seen to find out! 👊😉To become a Clubber, you need to be:* Future Era upwards* An active and insatiable fighting machine * Always wanting to grow and strive to be the best* Keen to be part of a dynamic teamAnd you should have:* Arc level 80 (preferably level 100+)* At least two guild-goods GBs as well as Arc(e.g. Obs; AIC; Hydra) or be willing to build and level upPlus you should be able to:* Complete GE 4 (and GE 5 if possible - because the Forgotten Temple is REALLY worth having!)* Step up during GbG seasons and Quantum Incursions and give it your all!The FightClub⚔️ perks:* Guidance, support and a wealth of knowledgefrom some of the best FoE players* Full Arc Boost (Break Even) thread for all GBs(70% of our players have Arc 180)* A Blitz (Power Levelling) thread* Trade and Mud threads* External 1.9 thread available if desired* The legendary FightClub⚔️ atmosphere 😁If you think you have what it takes and are...Aged 18+ with a SoH (Sense of Humour)(because we are a naughty bunch 😛) then…Please contact one of our founders or leaders, or request to join via Application. ⚜️We all have potential within us, some more than others, but no one is born a champion. To become a champion - of anything - requires commitment, training, strength, education, dedication and massive effort.⚜️We Are FightClub⚔️We Fight For FC For Fun & Carnage!🗡️😜

Founded from scratch by the one and only Boa in March 2022, followed by the cat, the faithful dog, the viking and the panda.
Rebooted: December 2022
